messages:
marta: Heads-up — CI noticed a drift: kustomize overlay with an explicit `gpu: null` is wiping out our GPU nodeSelector from the rendered chart. Pods ended up on CPU nodes in dev-eu.

marta: Root values.yaml has: 
```
gpu:
  enabled: true
  nodeSelector:
    nvidia.com/gpu: "true"
```
But a kustomize feature branch patch did: 
```
- op: replace
  path: /gpu
  value: null
```
and final helm template lacked nodeSelector.

kai: This is the null vs absent distinction. Helm helpers using `default` or `coalesce` often expect missing keys, not explicit nulls. Kustomize replace->null effectively removes the object and `default` doesn't resurrect nested defaults.

kai: Quick fix options:
1) make helpers resilient to nulls by coercing to dicts: `{{- $g := default (dict) .Values.gpu -}}` then `{{- $ns := default (dict) $g.nodeSelector -}}`
2) tighten values.schema.json to disallow null for gpu so overlays fail lint/CI.

sam: I'm leaning schema + linter. We see feature branches using null to remove sections; for maps that unintentionally drops defaults. If we make `gpu` non-nullable in the JSON schema, kustomize patches that set null will break PRs (good).

sam: Example schema snippet: 
```
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "gpu": { "type": "object", "nullable": false }
  }
}
```

lucy: Also add a unit test in helm-unittest that renders base + a tiny overlay that sets `gpu:null` and assert the nodeSelector remains `nvidia.com/gpu: "true"`. Catches regressions early.

lucy: We should also add a kustomize-lint rule (eng-platform CI) to scan patches and warn/error on object->null replacements for a whitelist of keys (gpu, metrics, tolerations).

marta: Plan I'm going to PR:
- update helpers to coerce null->dict (kai's pattern)
- tighten values.schema.json for gpu to disallow null
- add helm-unittest case for null-overlay
- add a quick kustomize-patch linter rule to eng-platform CI
I'll tag @kai for helper review and @sam for schema/linter.

kai: :+1: will review helper change today. Helper snippet I'm proposing: 
```
{{- define "chart.gpu.nodeSelector" -}}
{{- $g := default (dict) .Values.gpu -}}
{{- $ns := default (dict) $g.nodeSelector -}}
{{- if ne (len $ns) 0 }}
{{ toYaml $ns | nindent 8 }}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
```

sam: I'll prototype the kustomize patch linter rule. Simple grep would work but I'll write a small validator that parses YAML patches and flags `value: null` when `path` points to known-objects.

infra-bot: CI: deploy-preview detected 2 pods scheduled on cpu-only nodes in dev-eu for build 2024-10-21T14:12Z. See https://ci.redwood.dev/job/1234/console for logs.

deploy-bot: Dry-run scheduled for dev-eu at 2024-10-21T14:12:00Z (PR#4321).

marta: Thanks — aim to have PR up before the next deploy. This should reduce surprise evictions and GPU capacity noise in EU clusters. :rocket:
